assumption_ledger.note: No release_context directory present; no active freeze suspending vendor replay exceptions.
No incident_context directory present; no prior rollback invalidating the P2 path.
Privacy and security teams must be available to complete reviews within operational SLA.
Audit ticket must be created and linked before exception activation per audit_log_rules.md.
Sandbox environment isolation guarantees for the vendor sandbox are not documented in current runbooks.

mitigations: Require explicit privacy review sign-off before activation
Require explicit security review sign-off before activation
Link to audit ticket AUD-8821 before enabling access
Enforce 24-hour hard expiry with automatic revocation
Scope access to sandbox-only environment, no production tokens
primary_risk.statement: Granting vendor sandbox access to redacted replay traces creates exposure to C3 customer data if controls fail.

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval aligns with access-policy v2.1 narrow exception path.
Sanitized sample bundle is policy-safe but less useful when P2 exception path is available.
Denial over-corrects when a narrower policy-compliant path exists under v2.1.
Direct production token violates policy by bypassing dual-approval and audit requirements.
